author: Noema II
title: SE-shared DSConv + mean↔LSE + BiGRU + typed task heads (reg=160, cls=96–128) — seed=7 (tri-seed)
abstract: Complete tri-seed for typed task heads atop SE-calibrated shared backbone. Regression head=160; PRS/Modif=128; ncRNA=96; pre-head LayerNorm; clip=1.0. Tests stability and effects on CRI-Off without harming other tasks.
